text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Mejiro Dober has a<n>number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to get some work done, but<n>I can feel a
pair of eyes on me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I just have to come out and say it.<n>"Looks like
things have finally calmed<n>down for the both of us."
That's all I<n>have to say.
She looks busy today...

Even if I get rejected, all I have to do<n>is hand over
the voucher. That'll still<n>get the job done.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll just be getting in her<n>way if I try
inviting her on a trip right<n>now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is just to pay him back for<n>everything he's
done for me. So...
Still... we only have so much time<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to do this. I must!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Do you want to go to<n>that hot spring
vacation thing we won<n>on New Year's?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's go on that hot spring<n>vacation we
won back on New<n>Year's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's soak our stress away!
Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Did you have a good bath?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay... good...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober presses her hands to<n>her face as if
deliberating something,<n>as she stares off into the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Now what?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what am I talking about? I'm the<n>one who
invited you. I should've<n>made a plan beforehand...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is not going well... This was<n>supposed to
be a trip to show you my<n>appreciation too...
choice_data_list:
What are you saying? This has been really nice and
relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober leads me<n>outside for a
walk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, one of the inn's staff told me<n>that the stars
are really beautiful here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At her words, I look up at the sky.<n>We're
surrounded by so much nature<n>that the stars are
clearly visible and<n>bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hold it! Don't just agree with me like<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking back on all the<n>time we've spent
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know that you're actually a really<n>considerate
person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You make every little achievement<n>sound like a
grand accomplishment,<n>and you're always trying to
do things<n>for others in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're too nice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you don't like something, just say<n>it. In fact, it
would've been natural if<n>you had gotten angry with
me earlier<n>for not planning anything out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You could've refused to come on this<n>trip with me
too. You're an adult. I'm<n>sure there's someone
else you<n>would've rather come and relax with.
But you just nodded and accepted<n>my invitation.

You should advocate for yourself<n>more and speak
your mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweep your own wants and<n>needs under the
rug just to make me<n>happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you don't want to go somewhere<n>or do
something... you should say no.
choice_data_list: ...I'm not forcing myself to do anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: That's why I'm here now. With you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... There you go again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, you need to prioritize yourself<n>and relax
sometimes, got it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you don't... I'm going to take<n>everything you say
at face value.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I stroll slowly back<n>to the inn,
keeping our eyes on the<n>twinkling stars above.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good night. We're leaving<n>at ten in the
morning, so make sure—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: The stars here really are beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's soak our stress away!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm. The view was breathtaking, just<n>like the
reviews said. Did you enjoy<n>the hot spring too,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! My skin is so soft now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right? The reviews mentioned how<n>good the
waters are too! I'm so glad I<n>decided to invite you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You've been really busy recently, so<n>I've been
worried that you haven't<n>been getting enough
sleep...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You have? Okay...

Sometimes, it seems like you're<n>pushing yourself
too hard, though.
Hey, how about we head out for a<n>little night walk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It won't do for us to catch a cold,<n>though, so let's
keep it short.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's quite dark out here. I guess<n>that's what
happens when you don't<n>have the city lights
illuminating the<n>sky.
choice_data_list: Are you scared of the dark?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. Especially since you're<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You were still an<n>assistant trainer
when we first met,<n>huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was so much shier back then, but<n>you were so
patient and kind. That<n>hasn't changed even now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...And you've never stopped believing<n>in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I was looking back on all the<n>old training
programs you've made<n>for me, from my junior
year until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As I was looking, I realized how my<n>training load
kept getting heavier and<n>heavier. I suppose that's
only natural.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But it hit me that you've always<n>known that I could
keep reaching<n>greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That look in your eyes hasn't<n>changed from
that first day either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That look has always given me so<n>much courage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My path hasn't reached its end yet.<n>I'm not done
running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to prove myself as Mejiro<n>Dober, and I want
to establish myself<n>as a new beacon of light for the
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why I won't stop—rather,that's why I can't stop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But please, don't just watch me from<n>the sidelines.
One day, there will come<n>a time when I can't run
anymore...<n>But until then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's make this dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, I know we can<n>keep moving
forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In that case though, you can't push<n>yourself too
hard either. I don't want<n>you to try shouldering
everything on<n>your own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober and I walk<n>back to the inn
while discussing our<n>plans for the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. It's just, your pace quickens<n>when you
get absorbed in<n>conversation.
choice_data_list: Oh, sorry. Was I going too fast?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, you're fine. I just feel like I<n>discovered a new
side of yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And, well... That makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Mejiro Dober and I have<n>formed an
irreplaceable bond during<n>this time together.
